title: Fincent transactions.json
description: Array of portfolio transactions in chronological order.

account_id.description: Reference to the account this transaction belongs to.

date.description: Transaction settlement date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol involved (null for account-level transactions such as fees).

quantity.description: Number of shares bought/sold (null for non-trade transactions).

price.description: Price per share at execution (null for non-trade transactions).

amount.description: Net cash amount: positive = cash in, negative = cash out.
